title: Retrieve Distribution with wcvp_distribution()
text: Use summarise_by_input = TRUE need one row per submitted name. Prefer output = "summary" new code; summarise_by_input = TRUE remains available compatibility. Use output = "spatial" joining spatial layer; use output = "full" matching diagnostics complete geographic labels needed. Keep default output need one row per taxon-area combination. Join level-3 spatial table later left_join(..., = c("LEVEL3_COD" = "area_code_l3")); package intentionally create geometries. taxon_rank = "order" taxon_rank = "higher" available names table includes matching order higher columns. columns native, introduced, extinct, location_doubtful can used filters final summary returned. wcvpdata installed, can omit wcvp_names wcvp_distributions use default backbone.

title: wcvpmatch
text: wcvpmatch standardizes scientific plant names reconciles World Checklist Vascular Plants (WCVP)-style backbone. combines parsing, exact fuzzy matching, accepted-name resolution, optional distribution retrieval single workflow. package built around three main pieces: classify_spnames() parses normalizes submitted names. wcvp_matching() resolves names WCVP-like backbone. wcvp_distribution() retrieves species, genus, family distribution WCVP name distribution tables.

what: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames
title: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames
text: Parse classify scientific plant names taxonomic components: genus, specific epithet, infraspecific rank, infraspecific epithet, author. Output aligned backbone convention: Orig.Genus Title Case (first letter uppercase, rest lowercase). Orig.Species Orig.Infraspecies epithets lowercase. Infra.Rank lowercase (subsp., var., subvar., f., subf.). Author recovered input preserved original casing/punctuation (forced uppercasing). Orig.Name reconstructed : genus + species + (rank + infra) + author. Robustness rules: cf. / aff. removed parsing preserved flags (has_cf, has_aff). Hybrid markers (x/\u00D7) standalone tokens removed had_hybrid = TRUE. sp. / spp. triggers genus-classification (Rank = 1, Orig.Species = NA) sets is_sp/is_spp. infraspecific rank present infraspecific epithet missing, sets rank_missing_infra = TRUE keeps Infra.Rank Orig.Infraspecies = NA. rank appears "late" (author-like tokens), parsing best-effort rank_late = TRUE. explicit rank third token exists, function can infer unranked infraspecific epithet third token looks epithet-like (lowercase), look like start author. case implied_infra = TRUE, Orig.Infraspecies filled, Infra.Rank = NA, Rank = 3.

title: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames
code: classify_spnames(splist)

title: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames
text: splist Character vector. Scientific plant names.

title: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames
text: tibble one row per input name standardized columns/flags: sorter Numeric index original order. Input.Name Original input string provided user. Orig.Name Reconstructed standardized name aligned backbone + original-cased author. Orig.Genus Genus Title Case. Orig.Species Specific epithet lowercase, NA genus-(sp./spp.). Author Recovered author string (original casing/punctuation) "". Orig.Infraspecies Infraspecific epithet lowercase (ranked implied), NA. Infra.Rank Infraspecific rank lowercase (subsp., var., subvar., f., subf.), NA. Rank Numeric level: 1 genus-, 2 genus+species, 3 includes infraspecific epithet. has_cf,has_aff,is_sp,is_spp,had_hybrid,rank_late,rank_missing_infra,had_na_author,implied_infra Logical flags.

title: Retrieve Tabular WCVP Distribution by Taxonomic Rank — wcvp_distribution
text: non-spatial tibble. default output = "standard" returns one row per matched query-area combination submitted resolved taxa, geographic hierarchy, four occurrence flags (12 columns). output = "full" additionally returns matching provenance identifiers. output = "spatial" returns taxon-area fields needed later spatial join. output = "summary" returns one row per input taxon collapsed text fields distribution, areas, area_codes, regions, continents, n_areas.

title: Retrieve Tabular WCVP Distribution by Taxonomic Rank — wcvp_distribution
text: Queries distribution records matching taxon name WCVP names table resolving corresponding rows WCVP distribution table. function designed around wcvpdata::wcvp_matching_names() wcvpdata::wcvp_distribution(), custom tables schema can also supplied. Matching performed fozziejoin, using compact lookup tables length-based prefiltering keep candidate set small. Species queries resolved two stages: genus candidates matched first, species names searched within candidate genera. species-level matches resolve synonyms names table contains accepted_plant_name_id, distribution recovered accepted taxon. queries species, accepted names preferred avoid double counting synonym records. result deliberately contains geometry require sf. area_code_l3 stable WGSrpd level-3 key intended later join user-supplied spatial object. Default names distribution tables cached current R session. Exact species queries use direct lookup; lowercase strings species keys full backbone built fuzzy query needs .

NULL, data read optional wcvpdata checklist available; otherwise pass target_df explicitly. prefilter_genus Logical. TRUE, prefilter target_df candidate genera (exact + fuzzy) running matching pipeline. allow_duplicates Logical. TRUE, duplicated taxon keys deduplicated internally matching expanded back original rows. Output includes input_index traceability original input. max_dist Maximum distance used fuzzy matching stages (genus, species, infraspecies). method string indicating fuzzy matching method (passed fozziejoin). Supported methods: "levenshtein": Levenshtein edit distance (default). "osa": Optimal string alignment. "damerau_levensthein" "dl": Damerau-Levenshtein distance. "hamming": Hamming distance (equal-length strings ). "lcs": Longest common subsequence. "qgram": Q-gram similarity (requires q). "cosine": Cosine similarity (requires q). "jaccard": Jaccard similarity (requires q). "jaro": Jaro similarity. "jaro_winkler" "jw": Jaro-Winkler similarity. "soundex": Soundex codes based National Archives standard. add_name_distance Logical. TRUE, add matched_dist pairwise distance input name (Input.Name fallback Orig.Name) matched_taxon_name. name_distance_method Method passed stringdist::stringdist add_name_distance = TRUE (example "osa"). profile Logical. TRUE, attach timing table "timings" attribute returned tibble, elapsed seconds per pipeline stage. output_name_style Naming style output columns: "snake_case" returns standardized lower snake_case names. "legacy" keeps historical mixed naming convention. output Output layout. "standard" (default) returns parsed, matched, accepted-name fields needed routine reconciliation. "full" additionally returns internal matching-stage flags, fuzzy distances, parsing diagnostics.

what: wcvpmatch: Taxonomic Name Reconciliation Against the 'WCVP' Backbone — wcvpmatch-package
title: wcvpmatch: Taxonomic Name Reconciliation Against the 'WCVP' Backbone — wcvpmatch-package
text: Standardizes reconciles scientific plant names World Checklist Vascular Plants ('WCVP')-style taxonomic backbone. package parses names taxonomic components applies staged exact fuzzy matching binomial trinomial inputs, including infraspecific rank-aware checks. also returns accepted-name context row-level matching flags support reproducible, auditable preprocessing downstream biodiversity, spatial, trait analyses. user-supplied backbone can passed 'target_df'; optional companion package 'wcvpdata' installed, default checklist can also used.
